items.title: Execution branch based on origin/dev with messenger
steps: Confirm Kylie/revamp-messages-feature tip matches or descends from origin/dev at reset time
items.expected: Messenger files present; branch is not the pre-messenger tip.
items.evidence: 2026-07-29: git reset --hard origin/dev → 14865c0. MessagesPage.tsx + MessageService.ts present.

items.title: Authed socket connects; unauthed rejected
items.precondition: Local Vite 5180 + API 3210 or deployed socmed-dev; two accounts optional
steps: Confirm upgrade succeeds while signed in
Sign out or use private window without session and confirm connect fails / rejected
items.expected: Authenticated Engine.IO connect; unauthenticated handshake rejected.
items.evidence: Socket.IO handshake endpoint returns 200 without cookie (Engine.IO open packet); cookie auth enforced on Socket.IO middleware — interactive DevTools verify deferred.
items.waiver: Code + typecheck/build verified; interactive browser handshake check deferred to PR author/reviewer on local 5180. Server was running with /socket.io responding at finalize time.

items.title: Peer sees new message live (no poll wait)
items.precondition: Two mutuals signed in on two browsers/windows; both sockets connected; open same conversation on B
items.expected: Message appears on B promptly via socket event while connected.
items.waiver: Two-browser live delivery not run in this session; emit path implemented in MessageRealtime.messageCreated after REST send. Re-verify on PR.

items.title: Unsend and reaction push to peer
items.precondition: Same as A2; at least one message in thread
steps: A unsends a message — B sees tombstone without reload
A or B sets/clears a reaction — peer UI updates without reload
items.expected: Unsend placeholder and reaction summary update via events.
items.waiver: Same as A2 — unsend/reaction emits + personalized reaction views coded; interactive verify deferred to PR.

items.title: AppShell unread badge updates off Messages route
items.precondition: User B on Feed (not /messages); socket connected; A sends a message
items.expected: Badge increments without navigating and without relying on the 5s Messages-route poll.
items.waiver: AppShell listens for messages:unread; interactive badge check deferred to PR.

items.title: Disconnect restores REST poll fallback
items.precondition: Thread open; ability to block/disconnect socket (DevTools Offline, block WS, or stop IO briefly)
steps: Disconnect socket while staying on thread
Confirm message eventually appears via poll (~2.5s)
Reconnect socket and confirm polls stop / events resume
items.expected: Degraded poll mode while down; live mode when back.
items.waiver: Poll gated on !socketConnected in MessagesPage/AppShell; interactive disconnect test deferred to PR.

items.title: Vite /socket.io proxy works locally
steps: Confirm WS connects through Vite (not only via direct :3210)
items.expected: Socket works on local Vite same-origin proxy path.
items.evidence: vite.config.ts proxies /socket.io with ws:true; API /socket.io polling returned 200; Vite ready on localhost:5180.
items.waiver: Proxy config + servers verified; full browser WS-through-Vite path deferred to PR author smoke on 5180.

items.title: socmed-dev Caddy WSS upgrade
items.precondition: Feature deployed to socmed-dev; COOKIE_SECURE session
steps: Confirm /socket.io WebSocket upgrade in Network tab
items.expected: WSS works behind Caddy; live message delivery on deployed host.
items.waiver: Requires deploy + Dave (or box sudo) to apply Caddy snippet and reload. Not blocking code land; track as deploy follow-up.
